Bundled host: React 19.1.1 and React DOM 19.1.1 (MIT)
Build tool: Vite 8.2.1 (not shipped as a runtime dependency)
Maintained source: scripts/excalidraw-bundle
Rebuild command: npm ci && npm test && npm run build

The JavaScript, CSS, locale chunks, and fonts in this directory are bundled
for FloralMD and loaded from the application bundle. Runtime network access
is not required. The build installs Excalidraw's complete upstream font tree
because those runtime asset URLs are not discovered by Vite automatically.
